title: monsonia lheritieri

It is a climbing shrub native to South Africa, known for its fragrant, yellow flowers and green, oval-shaped leaves. The health benefits of Monsonia lheritieri include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, likely due to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of Monsonia lheritieri include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
